books.title: Measure and Boundary
books.author: Cairnwatch Survey Office
lore_pages: A boundary is not real because a king draws it. It becomes real when roads bend around it, watchmen walk it, bridges serve it, and people remember where responsibility changes hands.
The Covenant therefore measures before it claims. Surveyors walk every line. No map is sacred if the ground disagrees with it.
Flight is rejected partly because it encourages maps without contact. From above, ravines disappear into lines and mountains into shading. A road remembers what a map forgets.

books.title: The Surveyor's Prayer
books.author: Seventh Chain Liturgy
lore_pages: Let my step be counted. Let my measure be honest. Let the hill remain a hill even when my chart wishes it flat.
Let me never move a mark merely because the road would be easier elsewhere. Let the map serve the land, not the land the map.
And if I am tempted by the view from above, remind me that knowledge without contact becomes contempt.

books.title: Roadmaster's Dispatch
books.author: Cairnwatch Roadmaster
lore_pages: Bridge crews are to repair the northern span before moving stone to the Citadel road. Two patrols failed to arrive because spring water undercut the old embankment.
Do not send complete destination measures with ordinary couriers. Divide X and Z between separate copies whenever practical. Elevation marks may accompany either half.
Senior officers complain this slows movement. That is the point. A captured messenger should reveal a road, not the whole kingdom.

books.title: Watch Register: Cairnwatch
books.author: Seventh Chain Watch
lore_pages: First light: clear. Midmorning: merchant train. Noon: two pilgrims. Afternoon: engine noise beyond cloud, no visual. Dusk: three patrols returned.
One captured Unmoored map showed distances measured from the air. The survey master called it 'accurate and ignorant.' It ignored every ford, grade, and pass.
All copied waymarks checked against the stone registry. Missing axes confirmed intentional.

books.title: Seal VII — The Palace of Weight
books.author: Cairnwatch Survey Office
lore_pages: The Palace of Weight contains the master road registry, the sealed maps, and the stone from which all official measures of the capital are checked.
Surveyors joke that the kingdom could survive the death of a Hierophant more easily than the loss of that stone.
The final approach is intentionally difficult to infer from ordinary regional maps. The capital's true measure is distributed among the Chains.
